name: replicate
description: Run and integrate cloud machine learning models through the Replicate platform — search the model catalog, create and poll predictions, cancel stuck jobs, and chain image, video, audio, and language models together via a single MCP toolset.

interface.shortDescription: Run cloud ML models (image, video, audio, language) through the Replicate platform.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can run hundreds of machine learning models through Replicate — generating images, transcribing audio, creating videos, or processing language. Discover models, run predictions, and chain multiple models together in a workflow. Whether you need a Stable Diffusion image, a Whisper transcription, or a video generation, just describe what you want and your agent handles the rest.
defaultPrompt: Generate an image of a sunset over a mountain landscape.
Transcribe this audio file for me.
Find a model that can upscale or edit this image.
